trap.label: because + oração
trap.wrong: The tension arises because of Ren is suspicious.
trap.right: The tension arises because Ren is suspicious.
trap.why: Em português “por causa de/porque” se misturam. Em inglês, because of + substantivo; because + oração.

fix.wrong: The scene takes place on a kitchen.
fix.right: The scene takes place in a kitchen.

fix.wrong: Ren is suspicious while Ola is lighthearted.
fix.right: Ren is suspicious, while Ola is lighthearted.

fix.wrong: This reveal that Ren distrusts Ola.
fix.right: This reveals that Ren distrusts Ola.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com because: “Because of his suspicion, Ren is tense.” (because he…)
rewrite.answer: Ren is tense because he is suspicious.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com because of: “Ren is tense because he is suspicious.” (because of his…)
rewrite.answer: Ren is tense because of his suspicion.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com while: “Ren is suspicious. Ola is calm.” (…, while…)
rewrite.answer: Ren is suspicious, while Ola is calm.
